title.tagline: a Vampire Survivors tribute, rewound to the 90s

mad_forest.name: Token Arcade
mad_forest.desc: The carpet glows, the cabinets hum, and something keeps eating the quarters.

inlaid_library.name: Sewer Tunnels
inlaid_library.desc: One long pipe under the city, ankle deep in ooze. Mind what got flushed in 1993.

dairy_plant.name: Rooftop Row
dairy_plant.desc: Tar, vents and satellite dishes as far as the skyline. Nobody comes up here.

gallo_tower.name: Neon Mall
gallo_tower.desc: Four hundred shops and not one open. The zombies are still browsing.

cappella_magna.name: The CRT Grid
cappella_magna.desc: Inside the screen, where the late fees come from. Do not adjust your set.

bloody_tear.name: Crimson Slap
bloody_tear.desc: Evolved Slap Bracelet. Can deal critical damage and absorb HP.

holy_wand.name: Laser Show
holy_wand.desc: Evolved Laser Pointer. Fires with no delay.

thousand_edge.name: Dart Barrage
thousand_edge.desc: Evolved Lawn Dart. Fires with no delay.

heaven_sword.name: Glow Disc
heaven_sword.desc: Evolved Boomerang. Can do critical damage.

hellfire.name: Roman Candle
hellfire.desc: Evolved Bottle Rocket. Passes through enemies.

soul_eater.name: Gym Sneaker
soul_eater.desc: Evolved Stink Bomb. Steals hearts. Power increases when recovering HP.

la_borra.name: Slush Flood
la_borra.desc: Evolved Soda Splash. Damaging zones follow you and grow when they move.

no_future.name: Hyper Ball
no_future.desc: Evolved Bouncy Ball. Explodes when bouncing and in retaliation.

thunder_loop.name: Tesla Coil
thunder_loop.desc: Evolved Plasma Globe. Projectiles strike twice.

gorgeous_moon.name: Disco Ball
gorgeous_moon.desc: Evolved Reset Button. Generates extra gems and gathers all of them.

vandalier.name: RC Biplane
vandalier.desc: Union of RC Plane and RC Jet.

phieraggi.name: Hydro Blaster
phieraggi.desc: Union of Red Squirt Gun and Blue Squirt Gun. Scales with Revivals.

vicious_hunger.name: Fat Cat
vicious_hunger.desc: Evolved Alley Cat. Might turn anything into gold.

mannajja.name: Power Ballad
mannajja.desc: Evolved Karaoke Mic. Might slow enemies down.

valkyrie_turner.name: Rocket Skates
valkyrie_turner.desc: Evolved Rollerblades. Bigger, longer, faster, stronger.

infinite_corridor.name: Rewinder
infinite_corridor.desc: Evolved Pause Button. Halves enemies' health.

crimson_shroud.name: Crash Helmet
crimson_shroud.desc: Evolved Bike Helmet. Caps incoming damage at 10. Retaliates when losing charges.

fuwalafuwaloo.name: Double Dutch
fuwalafuwaloo.desc: Union of Jump Rope and Crimson Slap. Critical hits might generate explosions.
